Facts:
- In 1976, Jayaprakash Narayan formed the People's Union for Civil Liberties in India as the People's Union for Civil Liberties and Democratic Rights.
- The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award of the Republic of India.
- In 1999, Jayaprakash Narayan was posthumously awarded the Bharat Ratna in recognition of his social work.
- Prakash Ambedkar founded the Bharatiya Republican Party - Bahujan Mahasangh, an Indian political party.
- Prakash Ambedkar is identified as a grandson of B. R. Ambedkar.
